claims.title: Fair ternary affine failures inherit a conditional #BIS barrier; overlap sampling faces a stronger known NFA baseline

status: source_derived_unreviewed; Exact wave artifacts and informed internal reconstructions preserved; no independent proof audit or scientific replay during intake. External correctness and exact priority UNKNOWN; acquisition-inclusive advantage NOT_DEMONSTRATED. No civilisation-level discovery or physical validation established.
interface: For explicitly supplied affine equations a_e dot x=b_e over F_2 and independent exact rational retention probabilities p_e, U is the probability the retained equations are inconsistent. The source supplies complete elementary reductions showing that an FPRAS for distinct fair-retained equations of arity at most three would yield an FPRAS for #BIS, conditional on the stated Feng–Fu–Guo two-terminal-unreliability theorem. This is an approximation-preserving implication, not unconditional impossibility of an FPRAS. Matrix construction, accuracy/confidence encodings and output bit costs are charged. Empirical probability calibration and justification of independence are outside the supplied computational model.
limits: Independently reconstruct the exact imported unreliability/#BIS premise, distinct fair arity-at-most-three gadgets and multiplicative error; audit the overlap inequality priority. Implement feasible-trellis construction and compare end to end with a complete modern #NFA FPRAS at matched exact inputs, relative accuracy and confidence; continue only for a demonstrable representation/runtime gain or sharper theorem.
